lessons.title: 1. Building REST API Endpoint Response Objects
lessons.description: Format backend REST API response dictionaries: `make_api_response(data, status)` returns a dict with the status code under `status_code` and the payload under `body`.
lessons.solution_code:
def make_api_response(data: dict, status: int = 200) -> dict:
    return {"status_code": status, "body": data}

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — More on Defining Functions — 'specify a default value for one or more arguments' (Tutorial)

learning_objectives: Build API response payloads as dictionaries with fixed keys
Use a default parameter value for optional arguments
Compose status codes and bodies into a single response object
